Synopsis:
    New Hampshire holds its 2026 Senate and House primaries. Moderate Democrat Chris Pappas is the frontrunner for the open Senate seat but faces a tightening race from progressive challenger Karishma Manzur, riding a broader wave of progressive primary upsets nationally. On the Republican side, John Sununu (Trump-endorsed) is the heavy favorite. The general election outcome will contribute to determining Senate control. Multiple competitive House primaries are also underway. The state's large independent voter bloc (40%) makes the general election genuinely competitive despite Harris narrowly carrying it in 2024.
